entradas.text: The phone started ringing. I took a deep breath as I held it to my ear.
She let out a laugh.
“Mr. Rayne. How pleasing it is to finally get a chance to speak with you in person. ”
“Excellent.”

“I am Queen Beatrice Livingston. The Queen of the Four Corners of Merkopa, Defender of Castle Tzarsbourgh, Conqueror of the Tranquil Sea, Stout Protector of the Ancient Lands of Rum, Descendant of the Most Honorable King Edward the First and the Ruler of Rumburg. ”
“Aren't those titles a bit old-fashioned?”
entradas.menu: “Aren't those titles a bit old-fashioned?”

entradas.text: “It is very nice to finally talk to you as well.”
entradas.menu: “It is very nice to finally talk to you as well.”

entradas.text: “I am afraid protocol must be observed.”
I was in my office, waiting for the call that could potentially change the future of Eastern Merkopa.
“Am I supposed to be impressed?”
entradas.menu: “Am I supposed to be impressed?”

entradas.text: “Indeed. You should be.”
“Now. I wanted to give you a call *personally* to thank you for your efforts in maintaining the peace in Eastern Merkopa.”
“The reparations Sordland paid were very well received by my people and we are forever thankful. Instead of burying the dark past, you are trying to heal the wounds.”
“Why now?”
“My aim is to have peace in Merkopa. Nothing more.”
entradas.menu: “My aim is to have peace in Merkopa. Nothing more.”

entradas.text: “I decided that Sordland would benefit from better relationships with its neighbors.”
entradas.menu: “I decided that Sordland would benefit from better relationships with its neighbors.”

entradas.text: “It was time to mend old wounds and rightfully pay for what we had done.”
entradas.menu: “It was time to mend old wounds and rightfully pay for what we had done.”

entradas.text: “You are quite an unusual president for Sordland, Mr. Rayne.”
“I applaud and thank you from the bottom of my heart.”
“I am hoping this will mark an end to the aggressions between our countries.”
entradas.menu: “I am hoping this will mark an end to the aggressions between our countries.”

entradas.text: “This is only the beginning. We have the potential to do so much more. Don't you think so?”
entradas.menu: “This is only the beginning. We have the potential to do so much more. Don't you think so?”

entradas.text: “Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “Of course. This is the beginning of a new era after all.”
“You read my mind.”
“You are very welcome.”
“I have an offer for you.”
“An offer that has the potential to improve the relationship between our countries once and for all.”
“Don't be alarmed.”
“I don't like the sound of this.”
entradas.menu: “I don't like the sound of this.”

entradas.text: “Go on.”
entradas.menu: “Go on.”

entradas.text: “What kind of an offer?”
entradas.menu: “What kind of an offer?”

entradas.text: “Peace is very fragile and costly, but I think we are off to a good start.”
“I would like to hold a peace summit between Sordland and Rumburg.”
“There is always a but, isn't there?”
entradas.menu: “There is always a but, isn't there?”

entradas.text: “What do you want?”
entradas.menu: “What do you want?”

entradas.text: I let her continue.
entradas.menu: Let her continue.

entradas.text: “I can't let my people suffer in the name of peace with Sordland.”
“I must admit your country has a resource that Rumburg has long yearned for.”
“But I do have a condition.”
“Natural gas.”
“I want you to expand the Sordish natural gas pipeline to Rumburg, and I want it 30% cheaper than your other neighbors.”

“If you accept, we will give Sordland licenses to make your own version of the KA-74. It should certainly be profitable in the long term, not to mention the aid it will give to your national defense.”
“And then we will have our peace summit -- and perhaps start talking about even more lucrative deals.”
“If you want your peace, you'll need to come up with a better deal than that.”
entradas.menu: “If you want your peace, you'll need to come up with a better deal than that.”

entradas.text: “I'm afraid Sordland is not in a position to accept this deal. I must refuse.”
entradas.menu: “I'm afraid Sordland is not in a position to accept this deal. I must refuse.”

entradas.text: “Anything in the name of peace in East Merkopa. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Anything in the name of peace in East Merkopa. I accept.” [-1 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “What do you think?”
“A pity. Really.”
“I thought you were different.”
“Most exquisite.”
“Mr. Rayne, you have proven yourself to be a better leader than I thought.”
“We have just written history on this short call.”
“My people will talk to your people, and we will make the deal official.”
“A pity. Really.”
“I thought you were different.”
“I'm afraid we are at the end of the reserved time for our call.”
“If that is all, I wish you a good afternoon.”
“Have a good afternoon, Ms. Livingston.”
entradas.menu: “Have a good afternoon, Ms. Livingston.”

entradas.text: I hung up the phone.
entradas.menu: Hang up.

entradas.text: “I'm afraid we are at the end of the reserved time for our call.”
“I wish you a good afternoon.”
The line dropped dead.
“I am certain that this will be the start of a lasting friendship.”
“As long as Rumburg respects its boundaries.”
entradas.menu: “As long as Rumburg respects its boundaries.”

entradas.text: “We have achieved so much in such a short span. It's been a pleasure.”
entradas.menu: “We have achieved so much in such a short span. It's been a pleasure.”

entradas.text: “I sure hope so.”
entradas.menu: “I sure hope so.”

entradas.text: “And as long as Sordland respects its own.”
“Likewise, Mr. Rayne.”
“Me too, Mr. Rayne.”
“I can't wait to meet with you in person at the peace summit. We have so much to talk about.”
“But for now, I'm afraid we are at the end of the reserved time for our call.”
“I wish you a wonderful afternoon.”
Was this the start of a new era?
The line dropped dead.
Just like that, I had thrown away any chance of a peace summit between Rumburg and Sordland.
Would our countries ever be able to reconcile?
“Forgive me for being so straightforward, but I have to ask.”
“Now. Given the circumstances, I never thought I would be giving you a personal phone call. Yet here we are.”
“Even after what Sordland has done, I am showing you my willingness to talk instead of cutting off communication.”
“Why did you call?”
entradas.menu: “Why did you call?”

entradas.text: “I did not hang up yet. That should show you *my* willingness to listen to your whining.”
entradas.menu: “I did not hang up yet. That should show you *my* willingness to listen to your whining.”

entradas.text: “You are so kind and generous.”
entradas.menu: “You are so kind and generous.”

entradas.text: “I assure you, there is no need for sarcasm, Mr. Rayne.”
“Such vulgarity... as expected.”
“My demands are simple. You will give us control of our stolen ancestral homelands, Estord and Narbel.”
“Those cities are surely of lesser importance to you judging by the way your country has treated them. That's all I ask.”
“I know it all, Mr. Rayne. I know all about your plans. I can read your every move.”
“I know that your military is weak and crumbling.”
“I know that Sordland is on the verge of being completely under the control of your general staff.”
“I am offering you a peaceful way out of your dire situation.”
“One does not have to look far to see the situation your military is in.”
“So, please. I beg you to have reason. Think of your citizens. Think of your people.”
“If you fail to comply, to put it simply, we will take them by force.”
“A war, Mr. Rayne.”
“Do not enter a war that you have no chance of winning.”
“Please listen to me carefully. This is your last chance.”
“You must be out of your mind if you thought I would give in to your threats.”
entradas.menu: “You must be out of your mind if you thought I would give in to your threats.”

entradas.text: “Only Estord and Narbel? Nothing else?”
entradas.menu: “Only Estord and Narbel? Nothing else?”

entradas.text: “You dare insult me? Your time is over, Your Highness. Along with your country. I will see you on the battlefield.”
entradas.menu: “You dare insult me? Your time is over, Your Highness. Along with your country. I will see you on the battlefield.”

entradas.text: “I will not lead my country to a war. Peace must be maintained by any means necessary.”
entradas.menu: “I will not lead my country to a war. Peace must be maintained by any means necessary.”

entradas.text: “A pity. Really.”
“At least my conscience is clear.”
“I have given you a chance and you refused. You have failed your people.”
“War it is then, Mr. Rayne.”
“You will regret your decision until your last breath.”
The line dropped dead.
And just like that, the Rumburg War had begun.
“That's all. Your two least important cities.”
“I am glad that you see it our way.”
“Do you comply with my demands?”
“You must be joking. I have a duty to protect this nation. I will not sell pieces of it.”
entradas.menu: “You must be joking. I have a duty to protect this nation. I will not sell pieces of it.”

entradas.text: “What are two backwater cities in the name of peace? I accept.”
entradas.menu: “What are two backwater cities in the name of peace? I accept.”

entradas.text: “Most exquisite.”
“Mr. Rayne, you have proven yourself to be a better leader than I thought.”
“You have protected your citizens and fulfilled your duty. For that, I applaud you.”
“My people will talk to your people and we will make the deal official.”
“For now, I'm afraid we are at the end of the reserved time for our call.”
“I wish you a wonderful afternoon.”
And just like that, part of my country was now Rumburg territory.
“Screw you.”
entradas.menu: “Screw you.”

entradas.text: “I understand your frustration, but you have made the better choice.”
“You will pay for this one day.”
entradas.menu: “You will pay for this one day.”

entradas.text: “No need for additional adversity at this point.”
“Goodbye, Mr. Rayne.”
“Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: I heard the voice of the Queen of Rumburg from the other side.
The line dropped dead.
Just like that, I had thrown away any chance of a peace summit between Rumburg and Sordland.
Just like that, there was about to be peace between Rumburg and Sordland.
The line dropped dead.
The decision wouldn't make me popular. But it was better than the alternative.
“Anything in the name of peace in East Merkopa. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Anything in the name of peace in East Merkopa. I accept.” [-2 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “Anything in the name of peace in East Merkopa. I accept.”
entradas.menu: “Anything in the name of peace in East Merkopa. I accept.” [-3 Government Budget]

entradas.text: “Wait. Not so fast. I will accept your deal.”
